title: Trump says he will form new 'AI Force' but continues to call AI fears a 'hoax'
key_facts: President Donald Trump said on Saturday, in a social media post, that the US would form an 'AI Force', likened to Space Force, and would appoint an AI czar in the near future.
He called fears around AI alignment a 'hoax' and said existing criminal and civil justice systems could deal with bad AI, so new regulation was not needed.
The article says another armed forces branch would need further action from Congress, and it is unclear what the AI Force would do.
The White House did not immediately respond to a request for comment.
Anthropic chief executive Dario Amodei published a blog post the week before calling to slow the pace of AI development; Sam Altman of OpenAI said his company would welcome a slower pace.
David Sacks, co-chair of Trump's science and technology council, said the starting point is the regulations that already exist.
quote_evidence: "We will also be looking for BAD, and we can do that, very easily, with our already existing Criminal and Civil Justice System," Trump wrote in the post announcing the new "AI Force."
It is unclear what the "AI Force" would be tasked with doing.
why_it_matters_hint: The President's new AI force and AI czar plan would shape US AI policy and defence, but its remit is not yet known.
